title: delphinium delavayi var. pogonanthum
intro: Delphinium delavayi var. pogonanthum, commonly known as Chinese larkspur, is a flowering plant species within the delphinium family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese larkspur include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its traditional medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of Delphinium delavayi var. pogonanthum include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
